zh: 阿姆斯特丹自由大学（Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam，简称VU）成立于1880年，由荷兰新教改革宗领袖、政治家亚伯拉罕·库珀（Abraham Kuyper）创立，位于荷兰首都阿姆斯特丹南部金融区。在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第194位。校名中"自由"指"脱离宗教和国家"，反映追求学术中立的信念。学校注重社会责任的教育理念，在计算机科学、法学、商业分析、社会科学、生命科学与健康（如牙医学、神经科学）等领域具有突出优势。
en: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (VU), founded in 1880 by Abraham Kuyper, a Dutch Protestant leader and politician, is located in the southern financial district of Amsterdam, the capital of the Netherlands. Ranked 194th in the QS World University Rankings 2026, the name "Vrije" (meaning "free") refers to "freedom from religious and state control", reflecting its commitment to academic neutrality. The university emphasizes social responsibility in education and excels in computer science, law, business analytics, social sciences, life sciences and health (such as dentistry and neuroscience).
